title: Classifier Intelligence Artifact
description: Stable, reviewed, versioned intelligence artifact that AI Lab owns as the single traceable source for future vLatamGlobal Classifier integration. A classifier intelligence artifact wraps reviewed classification-relevant intelligence with evidence, provenance, jurisdiction, risk, review status, and explicit downstream eligibility. It is NOT raw LLM/provider output, NOT a duplicated parser result, and NOT a database/runtime export. Raw or unreviewed AI extraction is never an artifact of this kind. Synthetic/demo artifacts are never downstream-safe. A future consumer must read approved/versioned artifacts through a contract boundary, never AI Lab internals.

artifact_id.description: Deterministic, unique identifier for this artifact.

artifact_kind.description: Discriminator that pins this record to the classifier intelligence artifact contract. Any other shape (e.g. a raw provider response) is not an artifact of this kind.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this artifact payload schema.

artifact_version.description: Semantic version of the reviewed intelligence content carried by this artifact. Increments as reviewed intelligence is revised.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this artifact record was created.

updated_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when this artifact record was last updated.

reviewed_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when human review was completed. Required semantics live in the review object; this is a convenience marker.

provenance.description: Where this artifact comes from and how it was produced. Preserves traceability back to registered sources and (when AI-assisted) the generation lineage.

origin.description: How the intelligence was produced. AI-assisted extraction is allowed as an origin but is never approved by virtue of origin alone.

source_authority.description: Authority classification of the underlying source material. synthetic_demo and unverified material is never downstream-safe; only official_regulation or internal_review may back downstream-eligible artifacts.

source_set.description: Bounded source/evidence lineage references. At least one is required so every artifact stays traceable to a registered source.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction, nomenclature system, language, and product applicability for this artifact's intelligence.
Jurisdiction / country / pack scope label (e.g. demo, international, mercosur, ar). 'demo' denotes a synthetic, non-authoritative scope.

nomenclature_system.description: Classification nomenclature context (e.g. demo_tariff_nomenclature, hs, ncm). A demo_* system is synthetic and carries no real meaning.

language.description: Primary language of the referenced material (e.g. en, es).

product_scope.description: What product/material scope this intelligence applies to.

applicability_notes.description: Optional notes constraining where this intelligence applies.

effective_date.description: Optional effective date of the underlying instrument (YYYY-MM-DD).

validity_window.description: Optional validity window for the underlying instrument.

evidence.description: Bounded evidence that supports the extracted intelligence. Uses references/excerpt pointers following repo safety conventions, never large copied source text.

evidence_items.description: At least one evidence item is required so the artifact is never claim-only. Missing evidence fails validation.

intelligence.description: The extracted, classification-relevant intelligence. Normalized claims must trace back to evidence items.

normalized_claims.description: Normalized, classification-relevant claims. At least one is required.

classification_implications.description: Optional classification-relevant implications drawn from the claims.

constraints.description: Constraints that bound how this intelligence may be used.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made while producing this intelligence.

risk_flags.description: Optional risk flags raised during review.

review.description: Review and downstream-safety envelope. Review status and downstream eligibility are always explicit, never inferred silently.

review_status.description: Explicit human review state. Only reviewed_approved artifacts may ever be downstream-eligible.

human_review_required.description: Whether the artifact still requires human review before downstream use. True for any draft/synthetic artifact. May only be false once reviewed_approved.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether a downstream consumer (e.g. the future vLatamGlobal Classifier) may use this artifact. Defaults to false; requires reviewed_approved status and an authoritative, non-synthetic source.

downstream_eligibility_reason.description: Explicit, human-readable reason for the downstream eligibility decision (allowed or not). Never inferred silently.

classifier_approval_reference.description: Optional reference to a separate classifier-approval record. Required before downstream_allowed may be true.

limitations.description: Known limitations of this artifact. At least one is required so the artifact stays honest about scope.

disclaimer.description: Human-readable disclaimer about authority and downstream safety.

source_hash.description: Optional content fingerprint in sha256 format (with optional 'sha256:' prefix).

generationLineage.description: Optional lineage for AI-assisted generation. Present only when this artifact was produced from AI-assisted extraction. Its presence never implies approval.

evidence_reference.description: Bounded locator/pointer to the supporting material, never large copied source text.

source_authority.description: Authority classification of this specific evidence item.

confidence.description: Support confidence for triage only. Never implies approval.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence item ids that support this claim. At least one is required so claims stay traceable to evidence.

candidateClassification.description: Optional candidate classification framing. Candidate only; never an approved classification decision.

reviewer.description: Reviewer metadata. Required for downstream-eligible artifacts.

allOf.description: Synthetic/demo artifacts are never downstream-safe and always require human review. If the source authority is synthetic_demo or the origin is synthetic_demo, downstream_allowed must be false and human_review_required must be true.

Downstream eligibility requires explicit human review approval and an authoritative, non-synthetic source. If downstream_allowed is true, review_status must be reviewed_approved, human_review_required must be false, a reviewer must be present, a classifier approval reference must exist, and the source authority must be official_regulation or internal_review.
